$comment: The rose handoff close-up: Don Terciopelo on the picture's left, Mācron on the right, as in the nod. Every canvas is 400x440 and transparent, and nothing is mirrored. His four drawings are four Qwen edits of one bust crop of his accepted front sheet, scaled and placed by the bow tie so the head and shoulders hold still between cuts; the jacket's folds and the arm change. Mācron's are drawn from parts: only his picture-left arm, his eyes and the rose change. The rose is on Mācron's antenna from tuck on. Proposals by the art agent, 2026-11-07.

terciopelo.framing: bust: the canvas bottom cuts his belly
terciopelo.rose: in his lapel in rest and pluck, held out toward the picture's right edge in offer, gone in empty
